name: H R B P
summary:
Accomplished and results-driven Learning & Development Leader with 11
years of progressive experience in designing, implementing, and scaling
enterprise-wide training and talent development programs across corporate
India.
Strategically spearheading end-to-end L&D initiatives, including training needs
analysis, curriculum design, program delivery, evaluation, and ROI
measurement, impacting leadership, sales, and functional teams across PAN
India.
Proven expertise in creating transformative learning ecosystems, integrating
virtual, in-person, and LMS-based training, and aligning programs with
organizational strategy and business objectives
Pivotal in conceptualizing high-impact programs in Leadership Development,
Behavioral Skills, Soft Skills, Sales Enablement, and Train-the-Trainer
frameworks, consistently enhancing employee engagement, performance, and
retention.
Proven success in establishing L&D functions from scratch, formulating policies,
and embedding a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.
Strong business acumen with experience in HR business partnering, aligning
learning interventions with regional sales strategies and operational goals.
Recognized for strategic program leadership, stakeholder management, and
driving measurable outcomes, earning accolades such as Exemplary
Performance Award and “Extra Mile Employee” recognition.
Skilled communicator and influencer, capable of steering organizational
learning strategies, mentoring managers, and fostering leadership
development initiatives that enhance workforce capability and business
impact.
Passionate about leveraging innovative learning methodologies, adult learning
principles, and technology-enabled solutions to drive sustainable
organizational growth.
